nodes.title: How to Resample
widgets_values:
1. Load an image (PNG recommended), disable the `Resampler` and 'Run' to get as much of the original image generation details as possible: model, lora, steps, sample, scheduler, seed, positive and negative prompts too. **Note:** The positive prompt displayed is likely to also include the negative prompt (an issue with the custom node). 2. Enable the Resampler. Doing so will enable ALL the Models and Resamplers, you will need to narrow the list down.
Select the expected model (01a toggles), set the parameters to match the original generation (only enable one model type). Set the LoRA and trigger words if possible to get as close as possible to the initial generation. 3. Select which Resampler to enabled.
"Initial" uses the provided model but does not add details, while "Extra" uses details daemon to add new details.
The "Reference" sheet might help you decide if you want to enable a given model given the original model. It also contains recommended settings for the `detail_amount` for b02. 4. Modify the exposed parameters of the enabled Resamplers; in particular the `denoise` and for b02 the `step_multiplier`. 6. Hit `Run` and decide if you like the result or want to try again with different parameters. 7. Use the saved image as the input to the next run to fix another component.
